title: Ask draws any subject well with nothing stored or coded for it
goal: A person can say 'make x' for any x and get a good drawing, because the quality comes from the model, the prompt, general drawing techniques and material looked up at the time of asking. The stored emoji drawings and the code written for particular subjects (a fox, a lighthouse, a skyline, mountains) come out of the app.
notes:
The user, 2026-10-20: 'the cat task is just an example. I want to be able to say make x without having to have a bunch of static cat examples. nothing hardcoded, just the quality bar is up either through prompting, model changes, dynamic sample lookups, or other techniques. i don't want a hardcoded anything.' Now a hard rule in queue/bin/runner-prompt.md and a principle in queue/objectives.json.

What is hardcoded today: 402dc64f added a Twemoji set looked up by noun (Resources/Drawings/drawings.json, DrawingLibrary.swift, 166 lines); a2585b65 added IllustrationPieces.swift (565 lines) with functions for exactly the eval's illustration cases (lighthouse, skyline, fox, mountains, forest), which is how it reached 88 on them. IllustrationPasses.swift, IllustrationGeometry.swift and IllustrationColor.swift may be general; keep what is, delete what names a subject. Waits on the held-out set, the model bake-off and the picture-model try so the replacement is measured, not guessed. The held-out score may dip at first; ship the general route anyway if it is the best general one, say so in the audit, and file the gap.
acceptance: Removed: the stored drawing set (Resources/Drawings, DrawingLibrary.swift) and every function that draws a particular subject (IllustrationPieces.swift: mountains, forest, cloud, stars, birds, lighthouse, cottage, skyline, fox, and any like them), with the routing that picks them. A grep in the audit shows no subject names left in drawing code

Kept only what works on any subject: gradients, path smoothing and simplifying, boolean shape operations, a light and shadow pass over whatever shapes exist, value and palette passes, the critique checks, the look-and-revise loop. The audit lists each technique kept and why it is general (it never names a subject)

The drawing route is the best general one measured, picked from: the model writing the drawing in passes with a better prompt, the winner of ask-runs-on-the-best-model-this-mac-can-hold-pic, the picture-model-then-trace route of try-drawing-with-a-local-picture-model-then-turn, reference pictures looked up at request time and studied (not traced), or a mix

Measured on the held-out set (the-test-set-cannot-be-passed-by-a-lookup-unseen), which includes subjects no runner has seen: the total is at or above today's held-out score, and the share of results from stored or coded subjects is 0

What agents and runners read says the new route, with no built-in drawing set left in it: the Photonz skill (plugin/skills/photonz/SKILL.md, the Drawing row says about a thousand built-in drawings today), the add_drawing row in docs/design/agent-mcp.md, and the Drawing a thing and Pieces sections of docs/design/ask.md

The eval's stored-or-coded share is reported on every run from now on, so a later runner cannot slip a template back in. Audit under queue/audits/ with before and after contact sheets on the held-out set. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: The held-out set and the stored-or-coded count are in (commit 936aa3d7): Scripts/ask-eval.sh run --engine ask --set held-out prints the total and a line 'drawings N stored, N template, N drawn for the request (X% looked up)'; Scripts/ask-eval.sh report shows the latest climb and held-out totals. 'stored' = the built-in drawing set, 'template' = Illustrator's coded scenes; your 0 share means both counts at 0. Held-out cases are never read one by one while you change Ask (runner-prompt, Hard rules): draw the held-out contact sheet (Scripts/ask-eval.sh sheet <run>) only for the audit after your last change.
